_about: VerifyAnswer guard vectors. Go-first (golang/answer/verify_answer.go); Go-owned test data until VerifyAnswer has a Python reference, then promoted to conformance/cases/. Written language-neutral so the Python and JS ports inherit them. Each case: answer + evidence units (+ optional checker scores keyed by unit id: [entailed, contradicted]) -> expected decision and, per claim in order, supported + a reason PREFIX. Cases marked must_refuse are the controls that keep the guards from being loosened.
